# M1 fixture provenance

OpenSearch 2.19 and 3.2 metadata and shared cluster-health wire shape, derived from the official
Cluster Information and Cluster Health API documentation linked in [testing](../../../docs/testing.md).
These fixtures are documentation-derived, not captures. All cluster/node names and IDs, version build
hashes and dates are synthetic; no source endpoint, account, data schema or credential is retained.
